No matter what type of company you work for, we expect that one of your biggest challenges will be designing great experiences for all of your users

In effect, your experiments are a way for your users to tell you what they think of your designs
Gathering data from experiments helps you make design decisions that are based first and foremost on your users and providing them the best possible experience
